name: noise-background
title: Noise Background
description: A soft full-bleed panel of drifting colour: violet-pink and warm orange blobs move slowly over deep blue-green, with a fine grain texture and a thin rainbow strip along the top edge.
use: A hero or call-to-action panel needs a warm moving colour wash without images or a shader.
avoid: The grain is loaded from a remote image, and the drift never pauses for reduced-motion users.
a11y: The grain image is correctly marked decorative with empty alt, but the endless drift has no prefers-reduced-motion check. (keyboard: n-a, labels: n-a, reduced motion: not handled)
looks: A full-bleed, soft-focus wash of colour with deep blue-green at the edges, a violet-pink area through the middle and a warm orange patch toward the right. A fine grain sits over the whole panel and a tiny grey label marks the centre.
behaves: Three radial colour blobs drift slowly in random directions, easing along and changing course every couple of seconds while staying inside the frame. A thin multicolour strip along the top edge slides in step with them.
customise: Gradient colours, grain intensity, drift speed, backdrop blur and the animating toggle are props; the layout is set through class names.
weight: light: Three radial gradient layers drift through motion values; no canvas or shader.
